<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_snc_agenticbpc.RenderDateTimeLocal</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Renders a date/time value as an local timezone adjusted ISO string.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RenderDateTimeLocal</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[function RenderDateTimeLocal(vDateTime)
{
	if (vDateTime === false || vDateTime == null || vDateTime == undefined)
	{
		return '';
	}
	
	if (GetType(vDateTime) == 'number')
	{
		var nTimeStamp = GetIntegerValue(vDateTime); 
		var date = new Date(0);
		date.setTime(nTimeStamp);
		
		var strResult = date.getUTCFullYear();
		strResult += '-'+StringPadStart(date.getUTCMonth()+1,2, '0');
		strResult += '-'+StringPadStart(date.getUTCDate(),2, '0');
		strResult += ' '+StringPadStart(date.getUTCHours(),2, '0');
		strResult += ':'+StringPadStart(date.getUTCMinutes(),2, '0');
		strResult += ':'+StringPadStart(date.getUTCSeconds(),2, '0');
		
		return strResult;
	}
	
	strDateTime = GetStringValue(vDateTime);
	
	var nTimestamp = ParseDateTime(strDateTime);
	if (nTimeStamp === false)
	{
		return '';
	}
	return RenderDateTimeLocal(nTimestamp);
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-07 11:47:43</sys_created_on><sys_id>0b593ca22b0407949083fe395e91bf39</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>RenderDateTimeLocal</sys_name><sys_package display_value="AgenticBusinessProcessConsultant WORK IN PROGRESS" source="x_snc_agenticbpc">672e2a382b0f36109083fe395e91bf3e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AgenticBusinessProcessConsultant WORK IN PROGRESS">672e2a382b0f36109083fe395e91bf3e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_0b593ca22b0407949083fe395e91bf39</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-07 11:47:43</sys_updated_on><x_snc_devtools_sys_ui_script/></sys_script_include></record_update>
